title: Ideal generated by minors of a finite matrix
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $p,n,r\ge0$, and let $A$ be a $p\times n$ matrix over $R$ [def-weil-matrix]. The $r$-minor ideal $J_r(A)$ is the ideal generated by the determinants [def-weil-pbc-matrix-determinant] of all $r\times r$ submatrices [def-weil-submatrix] obtained by choosing $r$ rows and $r$ columns in increasing order. Thus $J_0(A)=R$, and if $r>\min(p,n)$ then $J_r(A)=0$.
